groups.name: Intake & Coordination
groups.basis: Receives requests, routes work, creates Project Rooms, or provides an operating overview across workflows.

groups.name: Document Intake
groups.basis: Receives, identifies, organizes, or maintains source documents and operating procedures before downstream processing.

groups.name: Accounting & Project Data
groups.basis: Maintains financial calculations, invoice processing, project workbooks, templates, or structured project data.

groups.name: Real Estate Transactions
groups.basis: Supports property acquisition, valuation, buyer qualification, seller financing, transaction packaging, or project setup.

groups.name: Legal & Entity
groups.basis: Maintains litigation, confidential legal material, entity governance, ownership relationships, estate, or claim work.

groups.name: Publishing & Public Work
groups.basis: Develops books, drawings, voice/media assets, websites, or other public-facing content.

groups.name: Systems & Maintenance
groups.basis: Maintains computers, Codex operations, management support, purchasing tools, marketplace work, or system health.

groups.name: Other
groups.basis: Used when a Project Room does not yet have a supported assignment to one of the defined functional groups.
